'''Alpha Esports''' is a professional esports based in [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwan]].

On January 28th, 2022 they had left the [[PCS]]. <ref name="team disband">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/lolesportspcs/status/1486960685691006976|title=Teams Announced for the Pacific Championship Series 2022 Spring Split|date=2022-01-28 |author=[[PCS]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
